items.claim: Navajo Sterling accepted this short-notice fight while on vacation and drinking after getting the call.
items.quote: Navajo did say that he was on a bender that he was uh getting drunk and when he got the call he was getting drunk. He was on vacation but he accepted this fight because it's an opportunity that he would not deny.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is undefeated in the UFC.
items.quote: Sterling is undefeated with a big step up in competition.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling has very good submission defense.
items.quote: very good submission defense that I did like to see.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling pops right back up when taken down.
items.quote: He has been taken down before, but he pops right back up.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has had a lot of injuries.
items.quote: We know Jan has had a lot of injuries

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz can check low kicks very well.
items.quote: can check low kicks very well.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez spent 8 months in prison for crossing the border with a small amount of marijuana.
items.quote: he was in prison for 8 months because he got caught crossing the border with a small amount of marijuana.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez trained in prison during his time away to sharpen his skill set.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez has been training in prison during his time away to sharpen his skill set.

items.claim: Ian Garry is the only fighter to ever TKO Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think Gary's the only guy to ever TKO him in the first round or at all.
